summary: Fusion Fuel Green PLC filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, attaching a press release that announced a 51.0%-owned subsidiary, BioSteam Energy, began commercial operations and provided forward-looking statements about expected annual revenue of ~$0.7M from an initial project, potential carbon credit generation, and future project development rights. No transaction in the special-situations sense—this is a routine operational update from a foreign private issuer reporting subsidiary progress without any acquisition, divestiture, or structural change. No deal terms, premiums, or dates were provided.
